values.title:
Pursuing Continuous
Growth
values.desc: We view learning as a natural part of our business. We constantly improve ourselves, follow innovations, and evaluate every new experience as an opportunity to advance.

values.title:
Sincerity is Our
Golden Rule
values.desc: We believe trust, open communication, and mutual respect form the foundation of strong teams. We share our ideas freely, listen to each other, and grow together.

values.title:
We Love Collaborative
Work & Support
values.desc: We know the best results come from working together. We share our knowledge, support one another, and achieve common goals with true team spirit.

values.title:
Creating Great Memories
Together
values.desc: Beside successful projects, we collect unforgettable memories. We celebrate together, have fun together, and transform colleagueship into strong friendships.

values.title:
People Are Our Most
Valuable Asset
values.desc: We believe our greatest strength is our people. We build a working environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and supported in their growth.

values.title:
Caring for Employee
Comfort & Well-being
values.desc: We believe people who feel good are happier and more productive. That is why we continuously work to enhance our work environment and employee experience.

cultureP1: We also love learning together, creating together, supporting one another, coming up with new ideas during coffee breaks, and celebrating our achievements as a team.
cultureP2: Every day, we work on different projects, learn new things, and continue to grow. While doing so, we strive to maintain a sincere and friendly environment.
cultureP3: If you are someone who enjoys what you do, stays curious, loves learning, and wants to be part of a great team, we would be delighted to get to know you.
cultureCallout1: If you would like to work with us, you can follow the steps below.
cultureCallout2: We look forward to welcoming you to our team.

processList.title: CV Analysis
processList.desc: We review your CV. If we find it a good match for the role, we initiate our evaluation process to get to know you better.

processList.title: Telephone Interview with Human Resources
processList.desc: We share our candidate evaluation form and general aptitude, English, and technical assessments relevant to the position.

processList.title: Online Assessment
processList.desc: In our ~30-minute online meeting, we get to know you and chat about your technical competencies.

processList.title: Interview with HR Management
processList.desc: Through a realistic practical project, we get to know each other closer, allowing you to experience the work while we evaluate your skills.

processList.title: Technical Interview
processList.desc: In a meeting with department managers and our General Manager, we discuss our mutual expectations.

processList.title: Formal Proposal and Related Documentation
processList.desc: If we believe it is an exciting mutual match, we extend our offer and look forward to welcoming you as a Siskon team member.

detailsList.title: Siskon means "sister" in Finnish and its name is derived from the words System and Control, meaning,
The names of our meeting rooms come from the history of our company,
We reduce waste by using our own cups on Mondays,
We share our leftover food with our animal friends,
Filter coffee is never absent from the kitchen,
There's always a regular occupant of the front seat in the service,
Dieting can be a little difficult here,
You will soon find out why everyone calls it the "Siskon dance" once you encounter the door to the new meeting room.

finalCtaLine1: Perhaps you are reading this with a smile today;
finalCtaLine2: soon, you too will become part of these stories,
finalCtaLine3: and together we will write new ones.
finalCtaDesc: A great workplace is remembered not only by the work done; but also by memories created, shared values, and small details experienced every day. Such a work culture awaits you at Siskon.
